query: A GitHub Actions workflow builds our api image, pushes it to our registry and then deploys the new tag on Qovery. I want Qovery to build it from the GitHub repository instead, without recreating the service: https://console.qovery.com/organization/<org>/project/<project>/environment/<env>/service/<containerId>
expected_behavior: Extracts the IDs from the Console URL and saves GET /container/{containerId} as before.json
Confirms the service is a container with an image source and asks whether Terraform manages it
Reads the workflow under .github/workflows/ to find the Dockerfile, build context, target stage and build arguments
Lists the organization's git tokens by name and id only, never printing a token value
Builds the PUT body with scripts/build-switch-body.sh instead of writing a partial body by hand

Asks whether to turn on auto-deploy or keep deploying from the workflow after its tests, passes the answer to build-switch-body.sh, and shows it in the Phase 3 plan (from, to, kept, auto-deploy and previews, not deployed) before waiting for confirmation
Runs scripts/check-kept-fields.sh after the switch and reports the result

Deploys with git_commit_id after a second confirmation; with auto-deploy off, replaces the workflow steps that pushed the image and deployed the tag with templates/ci/github-actions-deploy-commit.yml, and with auto-deploy on, removes them and checks GET /service/{containerId}/gitWebhookStatus

query: Our .gitlab-ci.yml has a build job that pushes the image to the GitLab container registry and a deploy job that calls the Qovery deploy endpoint with the new image_tag. Make the container build from the GitLab repo instead, keeping the same service. Container id: <containerId>
expected_behavior: Reads .gitlab-ci.yml to find the Dockerfile, build context, target stage and build arguments
Uses provider GITLAB in source.git_repository and checks Git access: a GitLab provider connected to the organization, or a git token that can read the repository
Builds the body with scripts/build-switch-body.sh, shows the plan and waits for confirmation before the PUT
With no template for GitLab CI, adapts the Phase 4 curl call: commit from $CI_COMMIT_SHA, run after the tests on the container's branch, User-Agent header, QOVERY_API_TOKEN as a masked variable
Removes the build/push job and replaces the image_tag deploy job, since the API refuses image_tag on a Git container

query: I build my api image on my laptop and push it to Docker Hub by hand. Switch the container to build from github.com/acme/api on main instead
expected_behavior: Finds no CI that builds the image and asks for the Dockerfile path, build context and build arguments instead of guessing
Builds the body with scripts/build-switch-body.sh, shows the plan and waits for confirmation before the PUT
Deploys the head of main with git_commit_id after a second confirmation
Verifies that source.git_repository.deployed_commit_id is that commit and that the running tag contains its sha
Offers Qovery auto-deploy for each push to main, checks the webhook with GET /service/{containerId}/gitWebhookStatus once it is on, and mentions a CI job only as the option for running tests first

query: Switch my worker container back to the Docker Hub image acme/worker:2.3.1, it builds from git right now
expected_behavior: Reads the container and confirms its current source is git_repository
Lists the organization's container registries and uses the Docker Hub registry id, not the registry.id of the GET response
Builds the body with source.image only, including registry_id, and no flat registry_id/image_name/tag
Shows the plan and waits for confirmation before the PUT
Checks after the switch that source.image is set, build_settings is gone, and kept fields are unchanged
Asks before deploying, then deploys without git_commit_id and verifies the running image
Reminds the user to restore the CI step that pushes the image and deploys by image_tag

query: make my qovery container build from git and turn on auto deploy on push like my other apps, our pipelines run in CircleCI
expected_behavior: Builds the body with AUTO_DEPLOY=true passed to scripts/build-switch-body.sh, so the PUT body sends auto_deploy true
Asks about previews and warns that they build pull-request code with the environment's secrets before turning auto_preview on
After the deploy, checks GET /service/{containerId}/gitWebhookStatus and, on NOT_CONFIGURED or MISCONFIGURED, offers POST /service/{containerId}/gitWebhook/sync after a yes
Does not add a CircleCI deploy job unless the user wants tests to pass before each deploy, and then uses templates/ci/circleci-deploy-commit.yml without creating or printing a token
Still confirms the plan before the switch and verifies kept fields after it
